goal: Break up the oversized P2P message processing function into dedicated per-message helpers
Make code navigation, scoping, and future reviews easier for maintainers in net_processing
reviewability: Needs a rebase due to conflicts with master, but reviewing the move-only logic now is worthwhile
agreement: Strong support for improving readability and scoping across net_processing (stickies-v, theStack, maflcko)
Verified as a move-only refactor preserving semantics and thread annotations (pseudoramdom, thomasbuilds)
Tested locally with coverage and confirmed cleanups incorporated (l0rinc, pablomartin4btc)
Conceded objection that separate helpers add friction compared to a flat switch statement (davidgumberg)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it is an internal code cleanup that improves navigation and encapsulation in P2P processing
Does not fix bugs, alter network protocol behavior, or eliminate active protocol hazards
